facts: Synthetic approval workflow: ticket histories, queues, staffing, interviews and repeated total route times are available. Known routes pass through approval stages (1,2), (2,3), and (1,3). Within matched case type, staffing and demand, controlled calibration establishes additive stable stage waiting contributions with bounded timestamp error. Direct internal timestamps are unavailable in this fixture; ordinary timestamp comparison remains native practice.

All procedures can use the same route membership and total timings, including repeated observations and uncertainty bounds. Several nonnegative stage assignments may fit within those bounds. The route model applies only to this matched regime, not every organizational process.

The budget permits two additional route observations and one ordinary sandbox pilot of a candidate handoff change with a matched unchanged comparison.
